decision: the failed probe also printed a kernel WARN, not an oops
why: the probe error path removes its PM QoS request and drops the runtime PM reference, then the queued runtime suspend runs isys_runtime_pm_suspend on the same isys struct while the driver core frees it. evidence: /tmp/camre/work-dol/incident-dmesg.txt line 115; ipu7-isys.c isys_probe out_cleanup and isys_runtime_pm_suspend; kernel/power/qos.c:301
result: stock driver bug in a failure path, reachable on every ISYS reload when no 4 MB block is free
